tagline: Help Baker find the Great Conch Shell before Founder's Day!
generic_hint: Try talking to everyone, and click on anything that looks interesting.

bubble_catch.title: Bubble Catch
bubble_catch.instructions: Move the net with the mouse or arrow keys. Catch 5 bubbles in a row!
bubble_catch.retry_text: Whoops, one got away! Start a new streak.

shell_puzzle.title: Shell Puzzle
shell_puzzle.instructions: Click the big shells to change their colors until they match the pattern on the chest.
shell_puzzle.retry_text: Not quite! Look closely at the colors.
shell_puzzle.auto_text: The shells wiggle... and sort themselves out!

crab_dance.title: Dance Like a Crab
crab_dance.instructions: Watch Sidney's four dance moves, then repeat them.
crab_dance.keys_text: Use the arrow keys, or click the arrows

dj_beat.title: DJ Dolphin's Beat
dj_beat.instructions: Click the glowing note to keep the beat going. Eight notes to go!

ending.speaker: dj
ending.text: FISHES AND GENTLE-FINS! The Great Conch Shell is HOME! Founder's Day is ON!

ending.speaker: dj
ending.text: And would you LOOK at that shine! You can see the whole reef in it. Even my good side!

ending.speaker: bill
ending.text: Barnacle Bill squeezes into the back of the crowd, very carefully, and bumps into only two balloons.

ending.speaker: grandma
ending.text: Grandma Grouper hands out kelp cookies to everyone. Even the balloons get one.

ending.speaker: sidney
ending.text: Sidney the crab takes the dance floor at last. He dances sideways. He knocks over the cake. Everyone cheers anyway.

ending.speaker: shelly
ending.text: Shelly watches the whole festival with her glasses on. 'Oh! So THAT'S what everyone looks like!'

ending.speaker: clam
ending.text: Captain Clam tells the story of the Great Shell Rescue. By the third telling, Baker has wrestled a kraken.

ending.speaker: coral
ending.text: Coral finally stops worrying. For about four seconds. Then she wonders if the balloons are tied tight enough.

ending.speaker: baker
ending.text: Baker the Fish, Hero of Founder's Day, takes a bow... and then goes to find a snack.

ending.speaker: narrator
ending.text: THE END. Thank you for playing! You can keep exploring the reef, or replay the mini-games from the Menu.
